_comment: Merge this into ~/.claude/settings.json to activate the orchestrator. This installs an always-on UserPromptSubmit classifier hook, SubagentStart/Stop observability hooks, a SessionStart daemon launcher, and a status line. Remove or set "disableAllHooks": true to turn off.
_comment_auth: Optional bearer-token auth: export ORCH_TOKEN=<secret> in your shell env (or put the token in <BASE>/token) before the daemon starts. When set, /mcp + write endpoints (/reset, /overlay/*, /loop/start|stop) require it; reads stay open. Recommended whenever you expose the daemon beyond localhost (e.g. via a tunnel). Leave unset (default) for the open, back-compatible behavior.
